name: p1
style: Flat 2D side view illustration from a children's picture book about animals. {subject}, seen from the side, the whole animal visible, cute and friendly with a happy face but realistic proportions, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its lower or shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Bright warm colours, clean simple shapes. No green anywhere on the animal. No text, no snow, no ice, no water, no ground, no shadow, no scenery.

items.owl: A single round white snowy owl perched facing right, white feathers with a few small dark speckles, big yellow eyes, folded wings
